steps.entry_conditions: Skill invoked for an implementation, continuation or plan-only request.
inputs: optional: checkpoint, constitutional references, evidence destination, analysis/authority services
steps.action: Require the selected inputs; accept an empty project as valid; ask for the exact specification selection with AskUserQuestion when it is missing or ambiguous.
steps.completion_evidence: Inputs named; ambiguity raised as an explicit question rather than resolved by scanning all documents.

branches.condition: plan-only request or host Plan mode
branches.target: plan produced, workflow stops, no implementation write

steps.terminal_user_outcome: A bound input set, or a precise request for the missing selection.

steps.action: Resolve project identity and permissions; discover layout, manifests, tests, tools and ongoing changes; select and bind the literal evidence destination before the first write; capture bounded context.
steps.completion_evidence: Context record persisted with selected_evidence_value, selection_source, resolved_evidence_root and the output mapping.

branches.target: ask once with AskUserQuestion; no invented default

steps.terminal_user_outcome: A bound, verified evidence root, or one precise location request.

steps.action: Read every selected specification; inventory source-qualified requirements into the traceability record; resolve constitutional decisions; identify dependency edges and shared-contract ownership; record conflicts and material gaps.
steps.completion_evidence: Every selected requirement carries an ID and either a verification method or a precise gap.

branches.target: record a precise gap before dependent work

branches.condition: two documents declare incompatible interfaces for one shared contract
branches.target: record source-qualified conflict, ask for the specific decision, continue independent work

branches.condition: required prerequisite belongs to an unselected document
branches.target: ask whether to select it or supply an existing implementation; do not build or install implicitly

steps.terminal_user_outcome: A complete requirement inventory, or named gaps with the minimum decision needed.

steps.action: Inspect existing functionality for the same responsibility before adding; record reuse, extension, composition or new implementation; plan dependency-ordered slices with verification.
steps.completion_evidence: Slice plan carrying requirement IDs, ownership, consumed and provided contracts, dependencies and per-slice verification.

steps.entrypoint: SKILL.md workflow item 4 -> references/implementation.md, Red / Green / Refactor
steps.entry_conditions: Slice plan exists; commands resolved from actual manifests.
steps.executor: primary agent using Bash, Read, Write, Edit
steps.action: For each behavioral slice write focused failing tests and preserve the failure, implement the minimum real behavior, rerun the same tests, then refactor without changing tested behavior or public contracts.
steps.completion_evidence: One execution-record line per actual attempt, including setup failures and timeouts.

branches.condition: test executable absent or harness broken
branches.target: classify as prerequisite failure, not a valid red result
stop the dependent change and resolve the requirement; do not weaken, stub or suppress the assertion
record the no-refactor reason without artificial churn

steps.terminal_user_outcome: Verified slices with retained execution receipts.

steps.entrypoint: SKILL.md workflow item 4 -> references/implementation.md, QA and metrics
inputs: project policy thresholds and required platforms
steps.action: Run applicable regression, integration, negative-path, formatting, static-analysis, coverage and platform checks; declare candidate, required-case set, tools, metric definitions, source denominator, exclusions and thresholds before measurement.
outputs: metrics section of the delivery record
steps.completion_evidence: Raw measurements, tool and report locators, counts, exclusions and per-platform results.

branches.condition: project policy does not define a needed acceptance metric
branches.target: resolve the missing decision; no universal default; missing measurement reported unperformed

branches.condition: required native or platform check cannot execute on this host
branches.target: name the exact unperformed cases and retain a partial result

steps.terminal_user_outcome: A measured QA result, or named unperformed required checks.

steps.entrypoint: SKILL.md workflow items 5 and 6 -> references/evidence-resume.md and references/failure-delivery.md
steps.action: Reread the original destination selection and read back each promised file at its actual path; account for every selected requirement; choose COMPLETE, PARTIAL or BLOCKED; report external framework acceptance separately.
outputs: checkpoint from assets/checkpoint.md when yielding unfinished work
steps.completion_evidence: Required-versus-actual path comparison plus the supporting readback observation.

branches.condition: records written under a different root than the original selection
branches.target: requirement stays unverified; task is PARTIAL or BLOCKED; misplaced attempts preserved and reported, not silently relocated
acceptance NOT_EVALUATED; stop affected protected operations

steps.terminal_user_outcome: A development status with source-qualified requirement accounting and the next safe action.

steps.entry_conditions: User selects a resume or a specific checkpoint.
inputs: current specification, source and tool hashes
steps.action: Verify actual identities rather than restoring old source; re-read hashes; mark dependent results stale and plan the necessary reruns; reconcile owned jobs from observable process and output state before any retry.
steps.completion_evidence: Recorded drift, affected requirements and slices, carried-forward evidence with reasons, and the next safe action.

branches.condition: selected specification or shared-contract hashes differ from those bound at the checkpoint
branches.target: mark dependent results stale with planned reruns; retain unaffected evidence only where candidate and prerequisites still match

branches.condition: previously launched job has an unknown outcome
branches.target: inspect actual process and output state before retry; do not blindly replay

steps.terminal_user_outcome: Safe resumption from verified current state.

coverage_note: Eight steps traced from cited entrypoints in SKILL.md and the four reference files. Every mapped path terminates in a usable outcome, an explicit request for a material decision, or a concrete failure with retained evidence. No phase registry, fixed anatomy or separate worker is required of this package, and none was demanded.
